title: ImageDescription
description: Structured descriptions of each photo attached to a complaint. One entry per photo.

complaint_id.description: References the complaint these descriptions belong to

descriptions.description: One description per photo, in the same order as the attached photos

photo_index.description: 1-based index of the photo in the complaint

caption.description: Detailed objective description of what is visible: type of damage, materials, colors, lighting, composition, surroundings, scale, textures

objects.description: Relevant objects or elements visible in the photo

damage_indicators.description: Signs of damage, wear, or problems visible in the photo

not_in_text.description: Relevant elements visible in the photo that the neighbor did NOT mention in their text. Empty if everything mentioned.
